values: 战斗开始时在敌方半场潜伏并收集情报，主动释放时审讯一名敌人，造成定身和沉默效果。

When a battle starts, Evie conceals herself on the enemy side to gather intel. When this skill is actively used, Evie interrogates and immobilizes an enemy. If she has already gathered intel on them, they are also silenced.

被动地，伊芙在战斗开始时瞬移至对称位置的格子进行潜伏，处于无敌状态，期间每秒积累120点敌方警戒值，每次友军释放终极技能时，警戒值下降500点，当警戒值达到1000点或其他友军均阵亡时，伊芙将被识破，退出无敌状态。
进入潜伏时，立即开始收集1格范围内所有非召唤物敌人的情报，随后按敌方初始布阵位置与自身当前距离从近到远的顺序，依次收集剩余非召唤物敌人的情报，每次收集情报耗时4.5秒，且每收集一名敌人的情报，自身获得150点能量。收集所有敌人的情报后，伊芙将瞬移回布阵的格子并退出无敌状态。
主动释放时，选择累计输出最高的一名敌人进行持续6秒的审讯，审讯期间目标处于定身状态且每秒受到180% + 18% ATK的伤害，若已收集目标的情报，审讯期间还会沉默该敌人。

Passive. When a battle starts, Evie teleports to the symmetrical tile on the enemy side and enters concealment. While concealed, Evie is invincible and accumulates 120 Detection points every second. She loses 500 Detection points each time an ally casts their Ultimate. When her Detection reaches 1000, or if all allies are defeated, Evie is revealed and no longer invincible.
As soon as Evie enters concealment, she starts gathering intel on all non-summoned enemies within 1 tile. Once complete, she continues investigating the remaining non-summoned enemies one at a time, prioritizing from nearest to farthest based on their starting positions relative to her. Each investigation takes 4.5s, and when it is completed, Evie gains 150 Energy.
After gathering intel on all those enemies, Evie teleports back to her original tile and loses her invincibility.
Active. Evie interrogates the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt for 6s. During the interrogation, she deals 180% + 18% ATK damage to the enemy every second and immobilizes them. If she has already gathered intel on the target, the skill also silences them during the interrogation.
主动释放时，审讯时长提升至6.5秒。
Increases interrogation duration to 6.5s when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，审讯时长提升至7秒。
Increases interrogation duration to 7s when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，审讯时长提升至7.5秒。
Increases interrogation duration to 7.5s when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，审讯时长提升至8秒。
Increases interrogation duration to 8s when this skill is used actively.
使被收集情报的敌人魔抗下降。主动释放时，突进到敌人面前造成两次伤害。
Evie reduces the Magic DEF of enemies she has gathered intel on. When this skill is actively used, she dashes to the nearest enemy and deals damage to them twice.
被动地，伊芙收集到一名敌方英雄的情报后，使其魔抗永久降低20% + 2%，在潜伏期间收集到所有存活的敌方英雄的情报后，使全体敌人的魔抗额外降低25% + 2.5%。主动释放时，突进到最近的一名敌人面前，使用匕首对其造成2次220% ATK伤害。

Passive. When Evie finishes gathering intel on an enemy hero, that enemy hero's Magic DEF is permanently reduced by 20% + 2%. If she manages to gather intel on all surviving enemy heroes while concealed, the Magic DEF of all enemies is reduced by an extra 25% + 2.5%.
Active. Evie dashes to the nearest enemy and strikes them twice with her dagger, dealing 220% ATK damage with each hit.
主动释放时，造成的伤害提升至230% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 230% ATK when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，造成的伤害提升至240% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 240% ATK when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，造成的伤害提升至250% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 250% ATK when this skill is used actively.
派出羽毛笔跟随友军，羽毛笔会提供增益效果和治疗。
Evie sends a quill to follow an ally, buffing and healing them.
战斗开始时，伊芙召唤羽毛笔自动跟随最靠后的友军，后续每隔3秒使羽毛笔切换跟随至累计输出最高的友军，使其每秒恢复120% ATK生命值，并提高20% + 2%攻击力。当该友军累计造成自身初始攻击力250%伤害时，羽毛笔将向除当前跟随的友军以外最虚弱的两名友军分别发射一枚治疗球，治疗球可恢复45% + 6% ATK生命值，该效果每0.5秒内至多触发一次。

When a battle starts, Evie summons a quill to follow the rearmost ally. Afterward, every 3s, the quill switches to the ally with the highest cumulative damage dealt, restoring 120% ATK HP to them every second and increasing their ATK by 20% + 2%.
When the ally with the quill has dealt damage equal to 250% of their initial ATK, the quill shoots 1 healing orb at each of the 2 weakest allies other than the ally the quill is following, restoring 45% + 6% ATK HP to them. The effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
治疗球恢复的生命值提升至50% + 6% ATK。
Increases the orb's healing amount to 50% + 6% ATK.
治疗球恢复的生命值提升至55% + 6% ATK。
Increases the orb's healing amount to 55% + 6% ATK.
治疗球恢复的生命值提升至60% + 6% ATK。
Increases the orb's healing amount to 60% + 6% ATK.
战斗中，自身的治愈提升11点。
战斗中，自身的治愈提升15点。
战斗中，自身的治愈提升19点。
收集到所有敌人的情报后，对敌人造成额外的减益效果。
After gathering intel on all enemies, Evie inflicts debuffs on them.
伊芙收集到所有存活的敌方英雄的情报且未被识破后，立即对友军宣告情报内容。在本场战斗剩余时间内，被收集情报的敌人造成伤害降低25%，在非首领模式下，被收集情报的敌人对己方造成可驱散的负面效果时，还会使这些效果的持续时间降低30%。

If Evie gathers intel on every surviving enemy hero without being revealed, she shares her findings with her allies. With their weaknesses exposed, these enemies deal 25% less damage for the rest of the battle. In non-boss battles, the duration of dispellable debuffs inflicted on allies by these enemies is also reduced by 30%.
敌方造成伤害降低的幅度提升至30%，造成负面效果持续时间降低的幅度提升至40%。
Increases the reduction to enemy damage dealt to 30% and the reduction to their debuff durations to 40%.
在伊芙宣告情报内容后，敌方受到魔法伤害提高25%。
Enemies also take 25% more magic damage after Evie shares her findings with allies.
敌方造成伤害降低的幅度提升至35%，造成负面效果持续时间降低的幅度提升至50%。
Increases the reduction to enemy damage dealt to 35% and the reduction to their debuff durations to 50%.
收集到所有敌人的情报后，额外派出一根羽毛笔。
After gathering intel on all enemies, Evie sends out an extra quill.
在潜伏期间收集到所有存活的敌方英雄的情报后，额外召唤一根羽毛笔跟随输出次高的友军，每名友军至多被一根羽毛笔跟随。

After gathering intel on all surviving enemy heroes while concealed, Evie summons an extra quill to follow the ally with the second-highest cumulative damage dealt. Each ally can only be followed by one quill.
